package usecase

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/application/ports"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/domain"
)

const AssistancePolicyVersion = "practice-task-assistance-policy.v1"

type Runtime struct {
	Repository   ports.Repository
	Revisions    ports.RevisionProvider
	Student      ports.LearningActionPort
	Planner      ports.LearningRouteProvider
	Workspace    ports.WorkspacePort
	Validator    ports.ValidationPort
	Evidence     ports.EvidencePort
	Now          func() time.Time
	NewID        func() string
	locks        sync.Map
	workerCursor atomic.Uint64
}

func (runtime *Runtime) now() time.Time {
	if runtime.Now != nil {
		return runtime.Now().UTC()
	}
	return time.Now().UTC()
}

func (runtime *Runtime) newID() string {
	if runtime.NewID != nil {
		return runtime.NewID()
	}
	var value [16]byte
	if _, err := rand.Read(value[:]); err != nil {
		panic("crypto/rand unavailable")
	}
	value[6] = value[6]&0x0f | 0x40
	value[8] = value[8]&0x3f | 0x80
	return fmt.Sprintf("%08x-%04x-%04x-%04x-%012x", value[0:4], value[4:6], value[6:8], value[8:10], value[10:16])
}

func (runtime *Runtime) newLearningActionID(instanceID, revisionID string) (string, error) {
	for attempt := 0; attempt < 4; attempt++ {
		candidate := runtime.newID()
		if domain.IsCanonicalUUID(candidate) && candidate != instanceID && candidate != revisionID {
			return candidate, nil
		}
	}
	return "", errors.New("could not generate a distinct learning action ID")
}

func (runtime *Runtime) lockInstance(id string) func() {
	value, _ := runtime.locks.LoadOrStore(id, &sync.Mutex{})
	mutex := value.(*sync.Mutex)
	mutex.Lock()
	return mutex.Unlock
}

func (runtime *Runtime) Start(ctx context.Context, command domain.StartCommand) (domain.StartResult, int, error) {
	normalized, err := domain.NormalizeStartCommand(command)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StartResult{}, 0, err
	}
	digest, err := domain.StartCommandDigest(normalized)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StartResult{}, 0, err
	}
	unlock := runtime.lockInstance(normalized.IdempotencyKey)
	defer unlock()

	instance, err := runtime.Repository.GetInstanceByID(ctx, normalized.IdempotencyKey)
	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return domain.StartResult{}, 0, err
	}
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		envelope, fetchErr := runtime.Revisions.GetPublishedRevisionEnvelope(ctx, normalized.TaskRevisionID)
		if fetchErr != nil {
			if errors.Is(fetchErr, domain.ErrNotFound) {
				return domain.StartResult{}, 404, domain.ErrNotFound
			}
			return domain.StartResult{}, 503, domain.ErrDependency
		}
		projection, projectErr := domain.ProjectPublishedRevision(envelope, normalized.SolutionVariantID, normalized.SurfaceClassification)
		if projectErr != nil {
			if errors.Is(projectErr, domain.ErrVariantRequired) {
				return domain.StartResult{}, 422, domain.ErrVariantRequired
			}
			return domain.StartResult{}, 422, domain.ErrAuthoringDefect
		}
		instance = newTaskInstance(normalized, digest, envelope, projection, runtime.now())
		instance.LearningActionID, err = runtime.newLearningActionID(instance.ID, instance.TaskRevisionID)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.StartResult{}, 503, err
		}
		stored, created, createErr := runtime.Repository.CreateOrLoadStart(ctx, instance)
		if createErr != nil {
			return domain.StartResult{}, statusFor(createErr), createErr
		}
		if stored.StartCommandDigest != digest {
			return domain.StartResult{}, 409, domain.ErrIdempotency
		}
		instance = stored
		_ = created
	} else if instance.StudentID != normalized.StudentID || instance.StartCommandDigest != digest {
		return domain.StartResult{}, 409, domain.ErrIdempotency
	}

	if instance.Status == domain.TaskInstanceStarting {
		instance, err = runtime.provision(ctx, instance)
		if err != nil {
			// The immutable STARTING receipt remains queryable and resumable; dependency
			// failures are represented as 202 until all idempotent receipts are verified.
			latest, readErr := runtime.Repository.GetInstanceByID(ctx, instance.ID)
			if readErr == nil {
				instance = latest
			}
			return runtime.started(instance), 202, nil
		}
	}
	if instance.Status == domain.TaskInstanceCancelled {
		return domain.StartResult{}, 409, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	return runtime.started(instance), 200, nil
}

func newTaskInstance(command domain.StartCommand, digest string, envelope domain.RevisionEnvelope, projection domain.RevisionProjection, now time.Time) domain.TaskInstance {
	steps := append([]domain.Step(nil), projection.Steps...)
	for index := range steps {
		if index > 0 && steps[index].Required {
			steps[index].Status = "LOCKED"
		}
	}
	instance := domain.TaskInstance{Schema: domain.InstanceSchema, ID: command.IdempotencyKey, StudentID: command.StudentID,
		TaskRevisionID: envelope.Revision.ID, TaskRevisionDigest: projection.Digest, Status: domain.TaskInstanceStarting,
		SurfaceClassification: command.SurfaceClassification, Locale: command.Locale, LearningPathID: command.LearningPathID, LearningPathItemID: command.LearningPathItemID, RequirementID: command.RequirementID,
		SolutionVariantID: projection.VariantID, Steps: steps, StartedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
		RevisionSummary: projection.Summary, RevisionEnvelope: envelope, StartCommandDigest: digest,
		ReviewRequired: projection.ReviewRequired, AssistancePolicyVersion: AssistancePolicyVersion,
		WorkspaceBinding: domain.WorkspaceBinding{Schema: "practice-workspace-binding.v2", Available: false}}
	instance.LearningActionID = ""
	instance.Progress = progressFor(steps)
	setCurrentStep(&instance)
	return instance
}

func (runtime *Runtime) provision(ctx context.Context, instance domain.TaskInstance) (domain.TaskInstance, error) {
	if !instance.Provisioning.StudentReserved {
		binding, err := runtime.Student.Reserve(ctx, ports.ReserveLearningAction{StudentID: instance.StudentID,
			TaskInstanceID: instance.ID, TaskRevisionID: instance.TaskRevisionID, TaskRevisionDigest: instance.TaskRevisionDigest,
			LearningActionID: instance.LearningActionID, SurfaceClassification: instance.SurfaceClassification,
			LearningTargets: uniqueTargets(instance.Steps), LearningPathID: instance.LearningPathID, LearningPathItemID: instance.LearningPathItemID, RequirementID: instance.RequirementID, OccurredAt: instance.StartedAt})
		if err != nil {
			return instance, err
		}
		if !validLearningActionBinding(binding, instance, "RESERVED") {
			return instance, domain.ErrDependency
		}
		instance.LearningActionID = binding.LearningActionID
		if instance.LearningPathID != "" {
			if binding.LearningPathID != instance.LearningPathID {
				return instance, domain.ErrDependency
			}
			instance.LearningPathReference = &domain.LearningPathReference{ReferenceType: "practice", ReferenceID: instance.LearningPathID}
		}
		instance.Provisioning.StudentReserved = true
		var errSave error
		instance, errSave = runtime.Repository.SaveInstance(ctx, instance)
		if errSave != nil {
			return instance, errSave
		}
	}

	if !instance.Provisioning.RouteResolved {
		request, err := domain.BuildLearningRouteRequest(instance)
		if err != nil {
			return instance, err
		}
		encoded, err := json.Marshal(request)
		if err != nil {
			return instance, err
		}
		receipt, err := runtime.Planner.ResolveRoute(ctx, ports.ResolveLearningRoute{Request: encoded})
		if err != nil {
			return instance, err
		}
		if !validLearningRouteReceipt(receipt, instance) {
			return instance, domain.ErrDependency
		}
		instance.LearningRoute = receipt
		if err := applyRouteReadiness(&instance); err != nil {
			return instance, err
		}
		instance.Provisioning.RouteResolved = true
		instance.UpdatedAt = runtime.now()
		instance, err = runtime.Repository.SaveInstance(ctx, instance)
		if err != nil {
			return instance, err
		}
	}

	if !instance.Provisioning.WorkspaceCreated {
		var binding domain.WorkspaceBinding
		request := ports.CreateWorkspace{RequestID: instance.ID, StudentID: instance.StudentID, TaskInstanceID: instance.ID,
			TaskRevisionID: instance.TaskRevisionID, RevisionDigest: instance.TaskRevisionDigest,
			RuntimeProfile: runtimeProfile(instance.Steps), StarterFiles: starterFiles(instance.Steps)}
		binding, err := runtime.Workspace.CreateOrResumeWorkspace(ctx, request)
		if err != nil {
			return instance, err
		}
		if binding.Schema != "practice-workspace-binding.v2" || strings.TrimSpace(binding.SandboxID) == "" || !binding.Available {
			return instance, domain.ErrDependency
		}
		instance.WorkspaceBinding = binding
		instance.Provisioning.WorkspaceCreated = true
		instance.UpdatedAt = runtime.now()
		instance, err = runtime.Repository.SaveInstance(ctx, instance)
		if err != nil {
			return instance, err
		}
	}

	if !instance.Provisioning.StudentOpened {
		binding, err := runtime.Student.Open(ctx, ports.OpenLearningAction{StudentID: instance.StudentID, TaskInstanceID: instance.ID, LearningActionID: instance.LearningActionID})
		if err != nil {
			return instance, err
		}
		if !validLearningActionBinding(binding, instance, "OPEN") {
			return instance, domain.ErrDependency
		}
		instance.Provisioning.StudentOpened = true
		instance.Status = domain.TaskInstanceInProgress
		instance.UpdatedAt = runtime.now()
		instance, err = runtime.Repository.SaveInstance(ctx, instance)
		if err != nil {
			return instance, err
		}
	}
	return instance, nil
}

func (runtime *Runtime) started(instance domain.TaskInstance) domain.StartResult {
	return domain.StartResult{Schema: domain.StartedSchema, Instance: instance.PublicProjection(), Revision: instance.RevisionSummary}
}

func validLearningActionBinding(binding ports.LearningActionBinding, instance domain.TaskInstance, lifecycle string) bool {
	return domain.IsCanonicalUUID(instance.LearningActionID) && binding.LearningActionID == instance.LearningActionID &&
		binding.LearningActionID != instance.ID && binding.LearningActionID != instance.TaskRevisionID && binding.StudentID == instance.StudentID &&
		binding.TaskInstanceID == instance.ID && binding.TaskRevisionID == instance.TaskRevisionID && binding.TaskRevisionDigest == instance.TaskRevisionDigest &&
		binding.LearningPathItemID == instance.LearningPathItemID && binding.RequirementID == instance.RequirementID &&
		binding.SurfaceClassification == instance.SurfaceClassification && binding.LifecycleStatus == lifecycle &&
		sameTargets(binding.LearningTargets, uniqueTargets(instance.Steps)) && (instance.LearningPathID == "" || binding.LearningPathID == instance.LearningPathID)
}

func sameTargets(left, right []domain.Target) bool {
	if len(left) != len(right) {
		return false
	}
	for index := range left {
		if left[index] != right[index] {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func uniqueTargets(steps []domain.Step) []domain.Target {
	seen := map[string]struct{}{}
	var result []domain.Target
	for _, step := range steps {
		if !step.Required {
			continue
		}
		for _, target := range step.Targets {
			key := target.Type + "\x00" + target.Key + "\x00" + target.Version
			if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
				continue
			}
			seen[key] = struct{}{}
			result = append(result, target)
		}
	}
	return result
}

func validLearningRouteReceipt(receipt domain.LearningRouteReceipt, instance domain.TaskInstance) bool {
	if receipt.Schema != "student-task-learning-snapshot.v1" || receipt.StudentID != instance.StudentID || receipt.TaskInstanceID != instance.ID ||
		receipt.TaskRevisionID != instance.TaskRevisionID || receipt.TaskRevisionDigest != instance.TaskRevisionDigest || receipt.Locale != instance.Locale ||
		receipt.ID == "" || receipt.RouteDigest == "" || len(receipt.Steps) == 0 {
		return false
	}
	return true
}

func applyRouteReadiness(instance *domain.TaskInstance) error {
	var route []struct {
		StepID string `json:"step_id"`
		Ready  bool   `json:"ready"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(instance.LearningRoute.Steps, &route); err != nil || len(route) != len(instance.Steps) {
		return domain.ErrDependency
	}
	for index, item := range route {
		if item.StepID != instance.Steps[index].ID {
			return domain.ErrDependency
		}
		if instance.Steps[index].Status == "PASSED" {
			continue
		}
		if item.Ready {
			instance.Steps[index].Status = "AVAILABLE"
		} else {
			instance.Steps[index].Status = "LEARNING_REQUIRED"
		}
	}
	setCurrentStep(instance)
	return nil
}

func runtimeProfile(steps []domain.Step) json.RawMessage {
	for _, step := range steps {
		if step.Required {
			return append(json.RawMessage(nil), step.RuntimeProfile...)
		}
	}
	return json.RawMessage(`{}`)
}

func starterFiles(steps []domain.Step) []domain.WorkspaceFile {
	for _, step := range steps {
		if step.Required {
			return append([]domain.WorkspaceFile(nil), step.StarterFiles...)
		}
	}
	return []domain.WorkspaceFile{}
}

func progressFor(steps []domain.Step) domain.Progress {
	progress := domain.Progress{}
	for _, step := range steps {
		if step.Required {
			progress.TotalSteps++
			if step.Status == "PASSED" || step.Status == "CHECKPOINTED" {
				progress.PassedSteps++
			}
		}
	}
	if progress.TotalSteps > 0 {
		progress.Percentage = float64(progress.PassedSteps) * 100 / float64(progress.TotalSteps)
	}
	return progress
}

func setCurrentStep(instance *domain.TaskInstance) {
	instance.CurrentStep = nil
	for index := range instance.Steps {
		step := &instance.Steps[index]
		if step.Status == "PASSED" || step.Status == "CHECKPOINTED" || !step.Required {
			continue
		}
		copy := *step
		instance.CurrentStep = &copy
		break
	}
	instance.Progress = progressFor(instance.Steps)
}

func statusFor(err error) int {
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrInvalid), errors.Is(err, domain.ErrAuthoringDefect), errors.Is(err, domain.ErrVariantRequired):
		return 422
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound):
		return 404
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrIdempotency), errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict):
		return 409
	default:
		return 503
	}
}

func (runtime *Runtime) GetDetail(ctx context.Context, studentID, instanceID string) (domain.StartResult, error) {
	instance, err := runtime.Repository.GetInstance(ctx, studentID, instanceID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StartResult{}, err
	}
	return domain.StartResult{Schema: "practice-task-instance-detail.v2", Instance: instance.PublicProjection(), Revision: instance.RevisionSummary}, nil
}

func (runtime *Runtime) List(ctx context.Context, studentID, cursor string, limit int, status domain.TaskInstanceStatus) ([]domain.TaskInstance, string, error) {
	if !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(studentID) || limit < 1 || limit > 100 {
		return nil, "", domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	items, next, err := runtime.Repository.ListInstances(ctx, studentID, cursor, limit, status)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", err
	}
	for index := range items {
		items[index] = items[index].PublicProjection()
	}
	return items, next, nil
}

func (runtime *Runtime) Materialize(ctx context.Context, studentID, instanceID, stepID string) (MaterializationResult, error) {
	instance, err := runtime.Repository.GetInstance(ctx, studentID, instanceID)
	if err != nil {
		return MaterializationResult{}, err
	}
	if instance.Status == domain.TaskInstanceCancelled {
		return MaterializationResult{}, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	for _, step := range instance.Steps {
		if step.ID == stepID {
			value, projectionErr := projectStepMaterialization(instance, step)
			if projectionErr != nil {
				return MaterializationResult{}, projectionErr
			}
			materials, parseErr := plannerMaterialsForStep(instance.LearningRoute.Steps, step.ID)
			if parseErr != nil {
				return MaterializationResult{}, parseErr
			}
			replayed := true
			for _, material := range materials {
				receipt, materialErr := runtime.Planner.Materialize(ctx, ports.MaterializeLearningStep{TaskInstanceID: instance.ID, StepID: step.ID,
					RouteID: instance.LearningRoute.ID, RouteDigest: instance.LearningRoute.RouteDigest,
					MaterialKey: material.Key, GenerationKey: material.GenerationKey, Target: material.Target})
				if materialErr != nil {
					return MaterializationResult{}, materialErr
				}
				if receipt.Schema != "practice-learning-material.v1" || receipt.MaterialKey != material.Key || receipt.Target != material.Target ||
					!domain.IsCanonicalUUID(receipt.CourseID) || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(receipt.LessonID) {
					return MaterializationResult{}, domain.ErrDependency
				}
				if !receipt.Reused {
					replayed = false
				}
			}
			return MaterializationResult{Value: value, Replayed: replayed}, nil
		}
	}
	return MaterializationResult{}, domain.ErrNotFound
}

func parseCursor(cursor string) string {
	if cursor == "" {
		return ""
	}
	decoded, err := hex.DecodeString(cursor)
	if err != nil {
		return ""
	}
	return string(decoded)
}

func formatCursor(value string) string { return hex.EncodeToString([]byte(value)) }

func validatePreviewURL(value string) bool {
	if value == "" {
		return true
	}
	parsed, err := url.Parse(value)
	return err == nil && parsed.Scheme == "https" && parsed.Host != ""
}
